versions.changelog:
Initial public release of "SMART原则目标设定技能" — a general tool for transforming vague intentions into clear, actionable SMART goals across personal, team, project, quality, learning, or business domains.

- Converts ambiguous goals into SMART-compliant statements (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound)
- Automatically generates key results and staged action plans
- Identifies common pitfalls and offers correction suggestions
- Provides structured five-step process with built-in checklist and risk detection
- Supports various input formats including text, .md/.txt, .docx, .xlsx/.csv
- Integrates with strategic toolchain; ancillary to but not dependent on quality management contexts
